name: mirofish
description: MiroFish - 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.test: cd backend && uv run --frozen --python 3.11 pytest tests/test_api_artifacts.py tests/test_s2_scheduled_injection.py tests/test_simulation_runner_model_map.py tests/test_graphiti_dedup_bypass.py tests/test_model_router.py tests/test_model_routing.py tests/test_experimental_memory.py ../tests/test_entropy_metrics.py ../tests/test_checkpoints_temporal.py ../tests/test_run_bundle.py ../tests/test_simulation_db.py ../tests/test_wiki_memory.py ../tests/test_wiki_memory_additional.py ../tests/test_wiki_compiler.py ../tests/test_wiki_report_integration.py ../tests/test_wiki_smoke.py -q
